mechanism: Itraconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing betamethasone metabolism reduction and systemic corticosteroid exposure, while betamethasone may increase itraconazole metabolism through enzyme induction at higher doses.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider betamethasone dose reduction or alternative antifungal if prolonged use expected.
